formulas.formula: Every dollar you earn, from every source, in one place.
1. Sources: type the year, your yearly income goal, then each way you earn money with a monthly goal.
2. Income Log: add a row every time you get paid. Waiting on money? Set Status to Pending.
3. Month Report: pick a month to see each source vs. its goal, your biggest payments and more.
4. Monthly View: every source, every month. Pending: everything you're still waiting for.
5. Taxes: what to set aside from income that isn't taxed yet, by month and by quarter.
6. Dashboard: your whole year at a glance, with your goal progress.
Yes for a paycheck with tax taken out. No for side income: it's counted on Taxes.
When it arrives, change Status to Received (and the date, if it changed).
Leave it blank on Sources: the sheet uses today. The example uses Sep 30, 2027.
On Income Log, select columns B to H from row 6 down and press Delete.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: received, on track, or goal met.
Yellow: pending, or a little behind.
Red: behind, or something to check (a typo or an unknown source).
Thank you for your purchase! Here's to your best-earning year yet.
